notes_for_editor: The Forest Lookouts Suwanee page has a heading and an empty paragraph, so there is no build date, height, staffing, fire or status for this name. The NHLR Cedar Key (Suwannee) entry is a separate Levy County tower at 29.237940, -82.935888 (existing record us-fl-cedar-key-suwannee); the two are not linked in any source found, so they are not merged and the story does not treat them as one. Two searches found no Florida record tying the name Suwanee to that tower. The story is shorter than the 120-word guide minimum because the evidence is one empty page and one register entry. The coordinate correction is the record's main error.
